summary: @servicetitan/stylelint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<VERSION>/...), extracts it to a temp directory, chmod+x's the binary, then invokes it with execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle marked "// @bun @bun-cjs" with rotated string-array obfuscation (a WV8StW shift routine, an encoded literal table n7gIxM, hex-mangled identifiers) that is not human-readable and cannot be executed by Node. The declared main (dist/index.js) never references math_init.js; the obfuscated payload is reachable only through the preinstall's alternate-runtime execution path. A stylelint config has no functional reason to require a separate JavaScript runtime or an opaque compiled bundle. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: on npm install, an alternate JS engine is fetched and used to execute attacker-supplied obfuscated code, bypassing tools that only inspect Node-resolvable sources.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
